svg.title: Meteorologist — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as meteorologist, wearing a raincoat. Visible work cue: Three open cup-shaped anemometer heads connect to a central rotor above a slim instrument mast. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: long hair, a tapered face and round glasses.
